market_notes: Vietnamese-language readers are mostly domestic travellers arriving in Hanoi from other provinces, students and returning overseas Vietnamese. They already know traffic culture, so intent centres on procedures (CCCD as deposit, the 2024 road-traffic law licence classes A1/A), long-term rental for study or work, and self-ride trips to Hà Giang or Ninh Bình. Many type queries without diacritics; titles keep full diacritics.
